links.note: The image file is the official logo of Volcano Gym, displaying the text VOLCANO GYM prominently.
The logo uses a strict black background with white graphic elements and bold sans-serif typography for VOLCANO and GYM.
Embedded within the volcano icon is a small silhouette of an athletic or running human figure, reinforcing the gym/fitness theme.
The logo features a stylized triangular volcano/mountain shape rendered in white on a black background, with an eruption plume at the top.
The high-contrast black-and-white palette conveys a bold, modern, and strong brand identity fitting a fitness/gym context.
The volcano/mountain icon serves as the primary brand symbol, evoking power, intensity, and challenge — qualities associated with a gym.
